verdict.rationale: Brex sells a dedicated travel product with 'global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform' (brex-docs-39). Its API exposes trips (brex-docs-56) and booking objects that record whether a booking was out of policy and which travel-policy rules it broke (brex-docs-6), so policy is evaluated on the booking itself. A user's hands-on remark that 'Brex Travel was luxurious' (brex-comm-5) corroborates that in-platform booking exists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that flights and hotels specifically are bookable, evidence of whether out-of-policy bookings are blocked or routed for approval at booking time rather than just flagged, and in-depth first-party travel docs.
